title: IBAN Validator & Normalizer input
description: Paste IBANs (one per line) and/or CSV text. Every non-blank IBAN produces one result row and one billed event. Spaces, hyphens and lower case are fine.

ibans.title: IBANs
ibans.description: One IBAN per line, e.g. "GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32". To check a BIC as well, write "IBAN,BIC" on the same line, e.g. "NL91ABNA0417164300,ABNANL2A".

csvText.title: CSV text (optional)
csvText.description: Alternative or additional input: paste CSV text. With a header row containing "iban" (and optionally "bic" or "swift") those columns are used and all others are ignored. Without a header, column 1 is the IBAN and column 2 (if present) the BIC. Comma, semicolon, tab or pipe delimited.

maxItems.title: Maximum IBANs per run
maxItems.description: Safety cap: only the first N IBANs (list first, then CSV) are validated and billed.
